msc_findings: Review/proof audio must not be public.
Private staging proof must not be required by production deployment.
Finished II delivery audio may be public only after padding/bookends and Twinkle are baked in.
Buyer-facing audio needs BIC-level QA/QC before release.

biz_doctrine: Separate working proof, review proof, and customer delivery.
Only BIC-passed delivery objects may reach the customer.
Production release gates must test customer-ready outputs, not private workbench materials.
QA/QC standards must be traceable and repeatable.
